evidence: Figure 1 : SHAPE learns dexterous manipulation from egocentric human data. (a) Pretraining pairs human recordings, providing only retargeted end-effector (EEF) actions, with robot teleoperation (EEF and joint actions). (b) The backbone predicts discrete EEF tokens across both domains as an auxiliary target, while a shared flow-matching expert outputs independent EEF and joint streams. (c) Adding human data and discrete tokens in pretraining improves policies under both robot-demo and human-only fine-tuning (top), where direct joint and IK-based EEF readouts respectively excel (bottom).
